4 échantillons de latence seulement (auc: Only 4 samples of latency (none at 96 kHz), light on the processor, Windows and Mac (VST3 and AU).
Analyseur temps réel entrée et sortie, p: Real-time input and output analyser, factory presets (vocal, kick, bass, bus, master, 50 and 60 Hz hum removal) and user presets, Windows and Mac (VST3 and AU).
Aucune latence. Presets d'usine et prese: Zero latency. Factory presets and user presets. VST3 for Windows, VST3 and Audio Unit for Mac.
ECHO GUARD : si le son du stream revient: ECHO GUARD: if the stream's sound comes back into the DAW, the stream cuts before the echo turns into feedback. Your DAW's sound is never touched.
EchoBox est un delay créatif qui se règl: EchoBox is a creative delay you set up in a few moves and that travels, with a single knob, from the purest digital to the most worn-out tape. CHARACTER is the heart of the plugin. All the way left, pure, clean, precise digital: each repeat is an exact copy of the sound, with no filter or colour. Towards the middle, the repeats soften just slightly. In digital, a new time arrives through a clean crossfade, without bending the pitch. Around three quarters, a warm tape that gently saturates. All the way right, a worn, dark tape that wows. On the tape side, each repeat goes back through this character, and sinks into it a little more. ECHO: TIME from 20 ms to 2 s, or SYNC to the track's tempo in note values (from 1/32 to 1/1, dotted and triplets); FEEDBACK up to 110 %, where the echo runs away and sings on its own; MIX from the dry sound only to the echoes only; DELAY OUT sets the level of the echoes alone, from -30 to +6 dB, to fine-tune the delay as an insert. Three playback heads, at one, two and three times the time, combine like on a multi-head tape echo to create rhythms. FREEZE freezes the tape and loops it, without loss, while you play on top. COLOUR: TONE darkens or brightens the repeats with each pass; PITCH makes them go up or down from -12 to +12 semitones, cascading (+12 climbs octave by octave); WOBBLE makes the time unstable, wow and flutter on the tape side, regular and clean modulation on the digital side, like a chorus; PING-PONG sends the echoes from one side to the other; SPACE drops them into a reverb, which takes on a spring sound on the tape side. The screen shows what you're doing: on the left, the machine, a memory chip that becomes a reel-to-reel when you turn CHARACTER towards TAPE; on the right, the repeats a sound will produce, as tall as they come back loud, left above and right below, sharp and precise in digital, soft and smeared on tape, with the pitch each one reaches when PITCH is in play. A cursor starts from the last note played and lights up each echo as it sounds. At the bottom, what just came in and went out. 23 factory presets and personal presets, with a browser that sorts them by type (Tape, Digital, Pitch, Ambient, Rhythmic) and a search by name, A/B comparison, and the description of each control when you hover over it. Resizable window. Mono or stereo input, stereo output, zero latency. VST3 for Windows; VST3 and Audio Unit for Mac (Intel and Apple Silicon).
Écoute et boucle dans le plugin, choix d: Listen and loop in the plugin, choose the phrase, IN SYNC mode to hear it at the right moment without even dragging it, factory presets and user presets. Windows and Mac (VST3 and AU).
EQ paramétrique 8 bandes : zéro latence,: 8-band parametric EQ: zero latency, natural phase or linear phase.
Huit bandes à tirer directement sur l'an: Eight bands to drag directly on the analyser: bell, low and high shelf, notch, low-cut and high-cut from 12 to 48 dB per octave. Each band can become DYNAMIC: it only acts when its range goes over the threshold. The headphones let you listen to a band on its own by holding its point.
La façade d'origine : gain micro de 20 à: The original front panel: mic gain from 20 to 80 dB and line from −10 to +20 dB, 300 / 1200 Ω impedance, HIGH 12 kHz, MID from 0.36 to 7.2 kHz, LOW from 35 to 220 Hz, 18 dB/oct high-pass, EQL, PHASE and OUTPUT. On top: PAD, console fader, LEVEL MATCH to compare at equal level, A / B and presets.
La montée de reverb inversée parfaite, e: The perfect reverse reverb rise, in one move: play, stop, drag.
La reverb pour la voix : six espaces, EQ: The reverb for vocals: six spaces, EQ IN / OUT, STUTTER and tempo-synced tail.
Le bouton BPM cale la longueur de la rev: The BPM button locks the reverb length and the pre-delay to note values, at the DAW's tempo or the one you choose. STUTTER chops the tail to the tempo (CHOP, REPEAT, RAMP) and PULSE makes it breathe. Zero latency, factory presets and user presets, VST3 for Windows, VST3 and Audio Unit for Mac.
Le préampli et l'égaliseur classe A des: The class A preamp and equaliser of 1973 British consoles, recreated stage by stage.
Le son de ton DAW dans ton partage d'écr: Your DAW's sound in your Discord screen share, without leaving ASIO.
Le son de ton projet n'est jamais touché: Your project's sound is never touched, and the chosen video comes back by itself when the project reopens. .mp4 and .mov files, Windows and Mac.
ONIRIQUE N73 recrée le préampli micro et: ONIRIQUE N73 recreates the mic preamp and equaliser of the famous 1073 module from its original schematics: input and output transformers, class A amplifier cards, an equalisation network simulated like the real electrical circuit. The grain comes from the model itself: the more you push the gain, the more the output stage and its transformer speak up, first in the low end, just like the hardware.
Parfait pour composer sur un clip, un ex: Perfect for composing to a clip, a film excerpt or a TikTok video: the window instantly takes the video's format, 16:9, 9:16 or square, and resizes without distorting it.
Player ouvre ta vidéo dans une fenêtre d: Player opens your video in a window of your DAW, locked to your playback. You start the project, the video starts with it; you stop, it stops; you move the cursor, the image follows.
Pose ONIRIQUE RISER sur ta piste de voix: Put ONIRIQUE RISER on your vocal track and start playback: it captures the vocal by itself. When you stop, the rise is ready. Grab the waveform and drag it into your DAW, at the bar shown: it ends exactly where the vocal starts. No more exporting, reversing audio or hacking together a reverb track.
Six espaces pour la voix : ROOM, PLATE I: Six spaces for vocals: ROOM, PLATE I, PLATE II, HALL, SHIMMER and ONIRIQUE, a huge, dark hall that ripples and dreams. THE PORTAL shows the reverb head-on: each ring is a moment of the tail sinking into the depth, and you just slide inside it to set its size and length. The MIX keeps your vocal whole up to 50 %, and its padlock keeps your blend when you change presets.
Sortie vers VB-CABLE, choisie toute seul: Output to VB-CABLE, chosen automatically. No cable installed? INSTALL VB-CABLE downloads it, checks its signature and installs it for you.
Stream envoie le son de ton DAW vers Win: Stream sends your DAW's sound to Windows while the DAW stays on your sound card's ASIO. Put it last on the master, share the DAW window in Discord with sound on: your friends hear your session, and you don't hear anything twice.
SYNC éteint, c'est un lecteur libre : le: With SYNC off, it's a free player: play, pause, position bar, loop.
Ta vidéo dans ton DAW, calée sur ta lect: Your video in your DAW, locked to your playback.
Tes réglages sont gardés : le périphériq: Your settings are kept: the chosen device comes back automatically with each new project.
Trois traitements au choix, dans un menu: Three processing modes to choose from, in a drop-down menu, and the plugin always shows the one running. ZERO LATENCY: IIR filters matched to analogue, with no latency. NATURAL PHASE: an FIR computed from the exact analogue response, the phase of a real analogue EQ and highs that never tighten up, still with no latency. LINEAR PHASE: a 32,768-point FIR, no phase shift, the latency is compensated by your DAW.
Tu façonnes la reverb comme tu veux : un: You shape the reverb however you like: an EQ IN on what goes into the reverb and an EQ OUT on the tail, each with low-cut, low, mid, high and high-cut to drag with the mouse. DUCKING clears the reverb while you sing and opens it again between phrases. CLEAN removes sibilance and the muddy low mids, and clears the old tail with each new phrase. INFINITE freezes the feedback: the tail holds forever.
Un grand bouton pour la durée, au tempo: A big knob for the length, at the track's tempo (from one beat to 4 bars), sibilance cleaned automatically so no S pops out backwards, the VOCALBOX reverb (ROOM, PLATE, DARK, HALL, SHIMMER) and one-click effects: PHONE, CHORUS, TREMOLO, SWEEP, WIDE.
Vocal Mini est un plugin de traitement v: Vocal Mini is an all-in-one vocal processing plugin designed to get a clean, balanced and professional sound with ease. Thanks to its intuitive controls, it combines effective compression and essential tools to make your vocals shine in a fast, smooth workflow.
